description: This Java source file 'UelFunctions.java' implements a collection of utility functions for use within the Apache OFBiz framework's Unified Expression Language (UEL). It provides functions for date/time manipulation, mathematical operations, string operations, system properties, XML/HTML document processing, and screen rendering utilities. It also maps these functions so they can be invoked dynamically within UEL expressions.

classes.name: UelFunctions
classes.description: Implements a set of utility functions for Apache OFBiz's UEL, including date/time, math, string, system properties, XML/HTML processing, and screen id resolution.

classes.name: UelFunctions.Functions
classes.description: Maps UEL function names to their corresponding Java methods, facilitating dynamic invocation.
